heard: The 2025 dire wolf pups were actually gray wolves with 20 edits. Most people believe scientists successfully resurrected the ice age predator using ancient DNA. The dire wolf species vanished approximately 10,000 to 13,000 years ago. Instead of splicing ancient genetic material, researchers rewrote existing cells from modern gray wolves. Biologists made 20 targeted edits across 14 genes to mimic traits like a wider head. The modified embryos were implanted into surrogate domestic dogs and delivered via caesarean section. Independent experts and the IUCN argue these animals are simply hybrid gray wolves. The 2025 dire wolf pups were actually gray wolves with 20 edits.
